newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cesp started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cesp started as hold.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it started coverage of Sao Paulo statepower utility Cesp with a hold rating.

-- It said Cesp, Brazil's second largest generator, is expected to be privatized, but this process is likely to take several years, given the company's debt burden and uncertain regulatory environment.
-- It also said it sees upside for Cesp shares to a price target of 40 reais, based primarily on an expected 30 percent appreciation in the market value of its distribution assets.
-- It said, however, it does not believe that this potential upside compensates investors for the additional risk we see in holding Cesp shares.

-- "We therefore prefer Eletrobras ELE_pb.SA as the most compelling generation play in Brazil and LightPar LIP.SA as the best vehicle for participating in the privatization process in Sao Paulo," it added.
-- Cesp preferred shares traded flat at 33.50 reais at 1140 local/1340 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
